text: Hi everyone. My name is Tim Roughgarden and I'm thrilled to announce the new Columbia Ethereum Research center on Blockchain Protocol Design. This is a new research center housed here in Columbia Engineering, which I'll be directing. Funded primarily by the Ethereum foundation, the Center's mission is to support research and education to advance the development and understanding of blockchain protocols and their applications, both Ethereum and and beyond. There's going to be a ton of activities associated with the Center. There's going to be lots of research grants supporting fundamental advances, helping blockchain technology become the best version of itself. Lots of people are going to be associated with the Center. Graduate students, postdoctoral scholars, industry researchers will spend time with us in residence here at Columbia. Lots of events. Maybe you've been to the Columbia Crypto Economics Workshop at some point the last few Decembers. That's now going to be one of the Center's activities, along with an annual summer school seminars, lots of other stuff. So if you want to know more about the center and its ongoing activities, check out the Center's website, follow me or the center on Socials. And there's also an opportunity for you to get directly involved. So, the Ethereum foundation, in addition to their very generous donation of one and a half million dollars per year to help run the center, they have also pledged up to $500,000 per year in one to one matching donations. So if you would like to help unlock those matching donations from the Ethereum foundation and help support blockchain protocol design and their applications, I hope you'll consider contributing. Thanks very much.
